title: Official Yakuza modpack
description: This Modpack is made for the official Yakuza discord server
body:
A minecraft 1.21.1 modpack curated by the people of the Yakuza Discord server.
Serverlink: https://discord.gg/Yakuza

Explore the world of minecraft with expanded world generation, optimization, huge dungeon structures while the world is also inhabited by cobblemon!

                                            Features

Cobblemon as the main mod. in which the following are added to expand it:
Berry pouch
potany pots
badges
economy
structures and legendary spawn structures
EMI with cobblemon information integration
Raids
Ultra beasts
Safari
Mega evolution, dynamaxing, z-moves and terrastilizing
and gyms + progression with radical trainer mod
Legends arceus style quick battle/ aggression

As an addition the following is added:

Origins race selection
Overhauled sounds
Added mobs
Overhauled biome generation with help of tectonic and terralith
Futher improved generation with YUNG, When dungeons arise
Serene seasons
Iris, Sodium, etc for optimization
Reactive music
Waystones for easy navigation through the world
Refined storaged powered with Powah for infinite storage options
Xaeros mini and worldmap

The modpack includes the server which is made for the Discord group. One must be added/ whitelisted to the server to be able to join!

                                              FAQ

Q: Does the modpack support multiplayer.
A: Yes, we have build a server based on these mods. there are some mods that are client only so this could be removed if preffered

Q: How do I open the cobblemon summary/ select starter?
A: A mod has been added to support multi keybind settings. To open this you need to use shift + M

Q: Can I improve my fps?
A: Yes, first disable the complementary shaders and distant horizon. these two are the main things that impact fps

                                           Known bugs:

Rendering error when hovering over the to craft item in EMI. The reason and fix is to be found
